settings.description_body:
Introducing a little Halloween world with a whole lot of capybara charm! This Halloween Capybara Zen Garden turns a classic sand garden into a playful spooky-season display, featuring adorable capybaras dressed in festive costumes alongside pumpkins, stones, a haunted house, and other Halloween-inspired details. The miniature scene is perfect for adding personality to a desk, bookshelf, office, or cozy corner, while the sand garden brings an interactive touch that lets you rearrange the pieces and create your own tiny Halloween landscape.

Whether you're shopping for a capybara lover, Halloween enthusiast, coworker, friend, or someone who enjoys quirky desk decor, this miniature zen garden makes a fun and memorable gift for Halloween, birthdays, or just because. Cute rather than overly scary, it blends cozy autumn vibes with playful spooky details, making it easy to display throughout the season. Add it to your Halloween collection and let these costumed capybaras bring a little calm, character, and festive fun to your space.

settings.shipping_text:
Each item is made to order with care, so please allow 7–9 business days for processing and production before your order ships. Once shipped, delivery typically takes 3–7 business days, depending on your location and the shipping carrier.

We accept returns and exchanges within 7 days of delivery. Items must be returned in their original condition, and return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer. If your item arrives damaged or defective, please contact us as soon as possible so we can make it right.

Because production begins shortly after an order is placed, changes or cancellations can only be requested within 24 hours of purchase. If you have any questions about your order, feel free to reach out — we’re always happy to help.
